steps.title: Your details
steps.blurb: Who you are and how we reach you.

steps.title: Your offer
steps.blurb: What you sell and why people buy it. We write the emails from this.

steps.title: Who we should reach
steps.blurb: The companies and people we build your lists from.

steps.title: How we send
steps.blurb: Who the emails come from, and where the meetings go.

steps.title: Access
steps.blurb: The tools we need to get into. If something is not done yet, choose Not yet. We will do it with you on the call.

steps.title: Goals
steps.blurb: What good looks like for you.

steps.title: Review
steps.blurb: Check your answers. Nothing is sent until you press Submit.

flow.label: Your name
Your email
flow.help: We send updates about your account to this address.

flow.label: Best phone number for business
Company name
Company website

none_option.label: We do not have a website yet

flow.label: Who else on your team should we talk to?
flow.help: Name, job title and email for each person. Put each person on a new line.
flow.placeholder: e.g. Alex Kim, Head of Sales, alex@example.com

flow.label: What do you sell?
flow.help: Describe your main offer as you would to a new customer. What do they get, and how does it work?

flow.label: What result do your customers get?
flow.help: Use numbers if you can. For example: more booked calls in 60 days, or hours saved each week.

flow.label: Your best results with customers
flow.help: Two or three short stories or links. Who was the customer, what was the problem, and what changed?

flow.label: Why should a stranger trust you?
flow.help: Well-known customers, years in business, awards, numbers of customers served.

flow.label: Do you give a guarantee or a free trial?
Which industries do your best customers work in?
How big are the companies you sell to?
Which countries or regions should we target?
Which job titles make the decision to buy?
flow.placeholder: e.g. Founder, Head of Operations, Sales Director

flow.label: What problems make these people need you?
Who must we never contact?
flow.help: Current customers, partners, competitors or anyone else. Names or website addresses.

flow.label: Which outreach have you signed up for?
The LinkedIn profile we send from
Who should the emails come from?
flow.help: Name and job title for each sender. Most clients use two or three people.

flow.label: How many cold emails do you want to send each month?
flow.help: A rough number is fine. We plan your sending domains and inboxes from it.

none_option.label: Not sure yet. We will set it with you on the call.

flow.label: Your booking link for sales calls
flow.placeholder: e.g. a Calendly or Cal.com link

none_option.label: We do not have a booking link yet

flow.label: How many sales calls can you take each week?
Which CRM do you use?
Add us as a user in your CRM
flow.help: Use the email address in our welcome message. This lets us add new meetings and leads for you.

flow.label: Add our team to the calendar where sales calls are booked
Is there any access you cannot give us yet?
flow.help: Tell us what it is and why. For example, the login belongs to someone who is away. We will sort it out with you on the onboarding call.

flow.label: What would make the first 90 days a success for you?
flow.help: For example, a number of booked meetings or new customers.

flow.label: How many new sales meetings a month would you like?
Is there anything you are worried about?
flow.help: For example, something that went wrong with an agency before. We would rather know now.

flow.label: Anything else we should know before the onboarding call?

done.heading: That's everything. Thank you.
done.blurb: Your answers are in. We read them before your onboarding call, so the call starts with your business and not with questions you have already answered.

next.heading: What happens next
items: We read your answers and prepare for the onboarding call.
On the call we go through any access that is not done yet, and any answer you were not sure about.
Then we set up your sending domains and inboxes, build your first list and write the first emails.

links.heading: Book your onboarding call
links.body: Choose a time that suits you.
